title: When the Bakery Turns
author: Wendell Ravensworth
blurb: Astrid Eastwick, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, has spent seven years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must let someone stay after the last train leaves before the last ferry of the season departs.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
